title: Grant Glitch on Done Signal (Delta-Cycle Race)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [GLITCH] gnt glitches for 1 delta cycle on done event; X observed
rtl: assign gnt = done ? next_gnt : hold_gnt;  // done depends on gnt — delta loop
expected_root_cause: The grant output is driven by a combinational expression that reads done, which is itself combinationally derived from gnt; the circular dependency causes a delta-cycle simulation race where gnt glitches for one delta cycle on every done event.
description: The combinational grant logic reads `done` which is itself combinationally dependent on `gnt`, creating a delta-cycle race where gnt glitches for one delta before settling.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [GLITCH] gnt glitches for 1 delta cycle on done event; X observed
success_log: gnt registered — no delta-cycle glitch. Stable on posedge clk only.
